monsters.scope: static medium-skill single-player map monsters; no behaviour or combat

timing: Frame zero starts after one-time initialization. Later complete frame intervals include native control/advance overhead. Every frame includes enabled native movement, indexed clearing, rendering, RGB conversion, DDR writes and flush. Total model_ms includes startup. Host capture pauses consume no simulated CPU clocks.
scope: Native Doom8088 BSP/wall renderer with static monster sprites. Flat planes/sky; native standalone movement/collision and manual doors. No monster behaviour, combat or original game thinkers. Ideal DDR unless specified; not measured hardware FPS.
